name: SWAG (Splatting in the Wild images with Appearance-conditioned Gaussians)
definition: SWAG is an extension of 3D Gaussian Splatting designed to handle unstructured in-the-wild image collections by modeling appearance variations and handling transient objects (occluders) without supervision.
summary: SWAG extends 3D Gaussian Splatting for unstructured images by using per-image embeddings and an MLP to modulate color and opacity, disentangling static geometry from dynamic occluders and lighting.
